rows.en: This is our operation plan.
Understood.
So we infiltrate the designated points and recover the specified materials, correct?
That's right.
I've assigned the Celestial Being members to each operation area.

Operation A: "Recover the Emerium ore."
That one's on me and Arios.

Operation B: "Recover the Gundanium alloy."
That's Deathscythe Hell and Birth.

Operation C: "Raid the arms depot."
That's Sandrock and Heavyarms.
By the way, all of these operation areas are concentrated in the "Wasteland Zone."
Each team will be waiting on-site, so talk to them when you're ready to start the operation.
You can start with whichever operation you like.
Next, about Wing Gundam Zero and 00 Gundam...
The two of them both specialize in infiltration missions.
Wing Zero, keep working with the Hero Team. 00, you're joining it as of now.
Mission accepted.
Understood. Commencing infiltration.
The entrance to the "Wasteland Zone" is in the southwest part of the "Quicksand Zone."
Don't screw it up out there!
Still, the enemy's strong in every area. The Mobile Doll System, GN Drive Taus, psycommu...
The Mobile Doll System, GN Drive Taus, psycommu...
The enemy's seized all the cutting-edge tech from our home worlds and turned it into firepower.
So they're all guys who won't go down easy, huh? This is shaping up to be one tough fight.
Man, this is shaping up to be one tough fight.
If we all work together, I'm sure it'll turn out fine. This time we've even got the Hero Team with us.
Yeah... You know, I kinda get the feeling you might be right.
All right! The operation starts now! Everyone, head to your assigned operation area!
Everyone, head to your assigned operation area!
Hikari and I will stay at camp and take command. If you have any questions, come talk to us.
00 Gundam joined the party!
The heroes hurriedly began preparing for their operations...
...Mebius.
I'm entrusting this to you.
This is... the "Knight Brace"!
It's sure to prove useful in the battles to come.
But Hikari, what about you...!?
I've decided to dedicate myself to rear support as an engineer, so all of you can fight without worry.
Hikari...
{8074} and the team moved to camp.
...So, our final objective is to strike the enemy's home base, but...
To do that, we've gotta head out into the Ride Dungeon and take down Psycho Gundam.
Psycho Gundam...
The enemy even has something like that...
You know it?
That thing is a devil's machine.
...But it's a Gundam, right?
It looks like a Gundam, but it's far bigger and more powerful than any of us.
Sounds like that one's gonna give us trouble...
...Now, as for how we beat this Psycho Gundam...
We absolutely need to build a new "Ride Machine."
A Ride Machine?
It's a ship for traveling the Ride Dungeon and fighting the enemy.
We've been building it from the Ptolemaios II, which got wrecked in our last operation, but...
If we finish it with just our own tech, odds are we'll repeat what happened last time.
But thanks to the help of Ultraman Hikari and you guys on the Hero Team...
...it looks like we can finish a Ride Machine that can handle anything they throw at us.
I see. So, what's this operation plan?
I'll explain that.
Put simply, this operation plan is: "recover the materials needed to complete the Ride Machine."
We've been scouting enemy territory for some time now...
As a result, we were able to pin down where many of the materials in this Cube are located.
However, many of them were unidentified, with their properties and uses unknown.
But thanks to sharing information with all of you this time...
...we found out that several of them are materials useful for completing the Ride Machine.
And those are?
Hikari, would you take it from here?
Very well.
First, the "Emerium ore."
Emerium ore!?
You know it well, don't you, Zero?
Of course.
The very substance that makes up Planet Esmeralda is itself a source of super-energy... right?
Exactly.
We'll use it as the Ride Machine's main power source.
Whoa, that's amazing... The output must be insane.
Next, the "Gundanium alloy."
This can be used to reinforce the armor.
Our investigation shows the enemy is refining Gundanium alloy at a facility inside the Cube...
...and we've learned they hold a stock of it at an abnormally high grade.
Last, armaments...
For those, we'll storm the enemy's storehouse and take anything that looks usable.

notes.note: No speaker recovered; Nu Gundam continuing from 0.64 (legacy 0228.57 labels this Nu Gundam).
No speaker recovered; taken as Seravee, the plan's presenter (legacy variant gives it to the presenter, Rider 1).
Op A-C rows (0.68-0.70) keep a deliberate two-line layout (title / assignees) with \n.
'Wasteland Zone' coined for this area name, patterned on Quicksand Zone; not in glossary.
Tech list: Mobile Doll System (Wing), pseudo solar furnace = pseudo-GN Drive / GN Drive Tau (00), psycommu (UC). Same list in variant 0.82.
No speaker recovered; casual reply to Sandrock, taken as Deathscythe Hell (legacy variant 0228.79 gives it to W (Shotaro)).
'come talk to us': Seravee invites the listeners to talk to him or Hikari.
Name variable plus padding reduced to the tag, per brief.

Legacy 0228 rows are an older draft of the 0227 briefing with different speakers (Black RX / Rider 1 present instead of Cherudim / Seravee). Translated as written; 0227 lines used to resolve mis-decoded kanji.
Legacy: mis-decoded kanji read as 'heavily damaged' and 'proceeding' (matches 0227.24). Ptolemaios II per glossary.
Legacy: mis-decoded kanji read as 'high' (possibility), matching 0227.25.
Legacy text reads roughly 'all of those guys' where 0227.27 has 'all situations'; possibly mis-decoded. Rendered 'anything they throw at us' to cover both.
Legacy: mis-decoded compound read as 'enemy territory' (matches 0227.31).
Legacy: mis-decoded compound read as 'located in' this Cube; guess (0227.32 is worded differently).
Legacy: two mis-decoded compounds read as 'properties' and 'uses' (matches 0227.33).
Legacy: mis-decoded compound read as 'high concentration'; 0227.50 says 'high purity', so rendered 'high grade'.
